title: On-time payment rate per loan
prompt: Collections wants the on-time payment rate per loan. Loan_payments start at one row per payment — what do you need a row to represent instead?
grain: Starts at one row per payment; ends at one row per loan.
metricDefinition: on-time payments / total payments, per loan.
referenceSql: SELECT loan_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'on_time')::DOUBLE / count(*) AS on_time_rate FROM loan_payments GROUP BY loan_id
